How to Try Somatic Shaking for Stress Relief

Imagine you’ve just washed your hands, and there’s no towel. Give them a gentle shake, and then let your arms join in. That’s the start of a stress-management exercise that may help loosen your tense muscles and give you a break from anxious thoughts , says Kim Penberthy, a clinical psychologist and professor of research in psychiatric medicine at the UVA School of Medicine.
